business_rules.errorCase: ConditionalCheckFailedException is silently swallowed and event is considered already processed
business_rules.rule: eventId must be unique; duplicate Kinesis or SQS events with the same eventId must not overwrite existing DynamoDB items
business_rules.validation: Send same eventId twice with different data; first write is preserved

business_rules.errorCase: No SNS notification results in missed critical grid alert
business_rules.rule: Events with severity CRITICAL and age exceeding SLA threshold must trigger SNS notification
business_rules.validation: Timestamp older than threshold + severity CRITICAL triggers SNS publish call

business_rules.errorCase: Missing notification leaves grid operations team unaware of delivery failure
business_rules.rule: Events with status DELIVERY_FAILED must trigger SNS delivery failure notification
business_rules.validation: SQS message with status DELIVERY_FAILED triggers SNS publish with breachType DELIVERY_FAILURE

business_rules.errorCase: Accepting invalid events corrupts grid state stored in DynamoDB
business_rules.rule: POST /grid/events must reject payloads missing eventId or substationId with HTTP 400
business_rules.validation: Request without eventId returns 400 with error message listing missing fields

business_rules.errorCase: Missing Firehose call causes gap in analytics dataset
business_rules.rule: Every successfully processed event must be forwarded to Firehose for S3 archival
business_rules.validation: After DynamoDB write confirm Firehose PutRecord is called
